items.reason: This is the 5% benzoyl peroxide wash you asked for, and it helps reduce the look of breakouts along the jaw.
A light ceramide moisturizer helps keep skin comfortable and looking balanced while the wash may be drying.
A mineral SPF in the morning helps keep the look of post-breakout marks from deepening on your skin tone.

response.routine_note: Start by using the wash once a day on the jaw area, leave it on for about a minute before rinsing, and build up only if your skin stays comfortable (it can bleach towels and pillowcases). Follow with moisturizer, and add sunscreen every morning; if breakouts persist or feel painful after a couple of months, a dermatologist is the best next step.
